title: Accenture Technology Vision 2019: The Post-Digital Era is Upon Us: Are You Ready for What's Next?
notes: Five trends. Labels printed as 'Name: subtitle'; subtitle in note. Quotes are the trend summaries in the Introduction (which prints Trend 2 before Trend 1 for layout; entries follow the trend numbers and contents page). Published date from PDF creation date (2019-02-07). No fixed edition-level horizon ('in the coming years'). pdftotext dropped spaces in some words; spaces restored in quotes.

entries.label: DARQ Power
entries.quote: Distributed ledger technology, artificial intelligence, extended reality, and quantum computing will be the next set of new technologies to spark a step change, letting businesses reimagine entire industries.
entries.subject: DARQ technologies (distributed ledger, AI, extended reality, quantum computing)
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Understanding the DNA of DARQ'.

entries.label: Get to Know Me
entries.quote: Technology-driven interactions are creating an expanding technology identity for every consumer.
entries.subject: Consumer technology identity and personalization
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Unlock unique consumers and unique opportunities' (contents page; the Introduction prints 'customers').

entries.label: Human+ Worker
entries.quote: Workforces are becoming human+: each individual is empowered by their skillsets and knowledge plus a new, constantly growing set of capabilities made possible through technology.
entries.subject: Technology-augmented workforce
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Change the workplace or hinder the workforce'.

entries.label: Secure US to Secure ME
entries.quote: While ecosystem-driven business depends on interconnectedness, those connections increase companies’ exposures to risks.
entries.subject: Ecosystem cybersecurity
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Enterprises are not victims, they’re vectors'.

entries.label: MyMarkets
entries.quote: Technology is creating a world of intensely customized and on-demand experiences, and companies must reinvent their organizations to find and capture those opportunities as they come.
entries.subject: On-demand, momentary markets (and 5G)
entries.metric: business and IT executives who believe 5G will have a significant impact on their industries
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Meet consumers’ needs at the speed of now'. Contents prints 'MyMarkets'; trend page prints 'MY MARKETS'.
